notes:
Local runs only (colima 0.10.3 VM, Docker 29.5.2 linux/arm64, kind v0.33.0, helm v4.3.0, kubeconform v0.8.0, kubectl v1.37.1). No GitHub Actions run: every deploy-pack.yml job is pending-ci (README.md). Branch base 691a041dc; int (cc063bdac) merged as 1916ed65e without conflicts. The receipt commit is the head the static steps, the clean verifier run and both drills used; the kind lifecycle ran at 1916ed65e, and only the drill script and its test changed after it.
Non-zero exits, all expected or explained: (1) negative renders against chart 0.1.0 exit 1 by design. (2) deploy-verify.mjs --target http://127.0.0.1:1 and credentials-presence-check.mjs --json with an empty HOME exit 1: the spec's fail-closed negatives, no values printed. (3) The drill with image A from origin/main (cc063bdac) exit 1 at probe-a verify: main's Studio still runs the complete-ledger check, which its own live gateway session fails; the drill with image A from 2cb2f4f4c and B from the merged head passes all six steps. (4) The full vitest suite on the merged head exit 1: 112 failed of 23,202 (10 skipped by a hook timeout under load). 108 are in files that fail the same way on 691a041dc; 4 (adaptersDoctorLeaseCarriers, leaseRevocationFailClosed, universalAgentIntegrationLayer, core/hotReload) failed only under load and pass alone (44 of 44).
Monitor-key pins in the kind job and the drill are trust on first use (monitorPinSource in both receipts): they detect a later key swap, not a compromised first bootstrap.
Verify fix: Studio's native verify returns the separate state anchored-prefix (probe status verified-prefix) only when the task's session is closed and sealed, every row and sealed session verifies, the monitor key is pinned, and every unfinalized session other than the target (an unsealed legacy session such as the running gateway's, or an open or interrupted native session) is named. It never reports externally-anchored for that and never sets ok.
tests: the 15 S1 and S2 vitest files in the static job. Mutations M1-M30 all killed (mutations.json).
A durationMs of 0 means the command was not timed.
